notes: Narrated encounter (rule 11): the three say «كنا جلوسا عند أبي عبد الله» and Abu Abdillah speaks and acts in the scene. Source or only in the scene is not settled by the text, so the Imam is not written as a link and the reading ends at the three
«[10/166] رجال الكشي:» is the quoted book's label, not a link; «أبو عبد الله» after «عند» is a place (rule 6)
The first-person account («كنا جلوسا») with implicit transmission is a second rule-11 ground
